message: Live Windows 2.2.16 evidence: replacement migration created exactly one replacement page and waited for composer, but then failed after bootstrap path with rebind=failed reason=no_new_url and replacement_failed reason=no_new_url. Log sequence: replacement_legacy -> replacement -> page=replacement_create -> composer_wait -> ~36s later no_new_url. Current persisted shape is expected to be old saved control URL still bound; rebind_status=failed; rebind_bootstrap_sent=true; rebind_failure_reason=no_new_url; rebind_replacement_count=1; replacement_status=failed; replacement_failure_reason=no_new_url. Fix as Dispatcher 2.2.17 in agent-handoff only. Requirements: (1) Do NOT create another page for this state and do NOT resend CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP blindly. Add exactly one URL-scoped finalize/rescue path only for the specific no_new_url + bootstrap_sent=true + replacement already consumed state. (2) First inspect the existing marked replacement page if present, plus read-only scan of open ChatGPT pages. If any page already has a usable new /c/ URL and positive control identity (exact CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP user message and/or CONTROL READY assistant evidence), atomically commit that URL with replaced_from and mark replacement/finalize done. Never navigate unrelated conversation pages. (3) If the marked replacement page exists but is still on ChatGPT home, inspect exact evidence: messages, composer contents, generation state, URL. If exact CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP user message or CONTROL READY is already present, never resend; wait a longer bounded period (e.g. up to 60s) for a usable conversation URL while also scanning open ChatGPT pages for the same positive control identity. If a matching usable /c/ page appears, commit it. (4) If the composer still contains the exact CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP text and there is no matching user message/assistant response anywhere, treat that as strong evidence Enter did not submit. Permit exactly one submit-only retry on that same marked page (press Enter/click send as needed without re-filling text), with a separate persistent submit_retry latch written before the action. Then confirm submission by observing exact user message, generation start, or usable URL; never resend after positive evidence. If composer is empty and there is no positive evidence, fail closed rather than duplicating a possibly-submitted bootstrap. (5) Improve send_to_chatgpt for future provisioning/rebind: do not mark bootstrap sent merely before pressing Enter. Persist separate attempted/submitted confirmation state. After fill+submit, bounded-confirm at least one of: exact user message appears, generation becomes active, or usable conversation URL appears. If no confirmation and exact text remains in composer, allow one submit-only retry; otherwise fail closed. Keep logs token-only and never log CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP text. (6) A no_new_url timeout after confirmed submission must not destroy the ability to finalize later on the same page; separate submission from URL-finalization status. (7) Add tests for: existing new /c/ + positive identity => commit without resend; home page + exact bootstrap user message => wait/scan no resend; exact bootstrap still in composer => one submit-only retry; empty composer/no evidence => fail closed; restart de-dup; unrelated conversations untouched; matching control page found by read-only scan; successful delayed URL => commit; future send confirmation semantics. Preserve CHECK_INTERVAL=5, raw->api failover, one-page guarantees, main and arena/local-agent-v0 unchanged, no Phase 2/live mailbox. After commit write turn_id=51 target=GPT with SHA, changed files, exact tests, and finalize/send-confirmation semantics.
